title: One place for Echo error responses
summary: Move per handler c.JSON calls to echo.NewHTTPError and a custom HTTPErrorHandler, then stop sending he.Error() to the client.

turns.user: error json is different in every handler. error, message, msg. frontend is complaining. make it one thing

assistant.body: Sure! In Echo the handler just returns the error, and e.HTTPErrorHandler decides what the response looks like, in one place. When you want a status, return echo.NewHTTPError. The error from c.Bind is already a 400 *echo.HTTPError, so returning it as is is enough.

Here's the error handler. Put it in internal/handler/errors.go and set e.HTTPErrorHandler = handler.ErrorHandler in main. Anything that is not an HTTPError becomes a 500 and its text goes only to the log, so a database error never reaches the client.

turns.user: 404 now says {"error":"code=404, message=user not found"}. dont want code= in there, and on 400 there's internal= with the raw error in it

assistant.body: Apologies, my previous answer was incorrect. Error() on *echo.HTTPError is a log string that joins code= and message=, and adds internal= when SetInternal was called. The error from c.Bind is exactly that case. The response should carry Message and nothing else.

turns.user: actually make the key message. frontend guy prefers it

assistant.body: The key lives on one line of the error handler, so changing it there changes every handler. ErrorHandler is now the single source of truth for the error shape.
